title: US strike on residential building in Qeshm island kills 2-year-old child, father, mother.
text:
US strike on residential building in Qeshm island kills 2-year-old child, father, mother."

"First released Footage of the brutal last night's attack by the American Army on a residential home in a neighborhood of Qeshm Island, Hormozqan Province, which has so far resulted in three fatality. The status of other residents is unknown, July 30.
